content: Dawud d Juliyat
Ifilisṭiniyyen ssmunen řɛeskarat nsen i umenɣi u nitni nnyarwen ɣar Suku di temmurt n Yahuda. Wtin iqiḍan nsen jar Suku d Ɛaziqqa ɣar Afas-Dammim.
Uřa d Cawul d yeryazen n Israil nnyarwen uca wtin iqiḍan nsen di Teɣzurt n Ila. Nitni sedden ixef nsen i umenɣi qibač i Ifilisṭiniyyen.
Ifilisṭiniyyen bedden x wedrar ɣar uɣezdis-a u Israiliyyen bedden x wedrar ɣar uɣezdis nni u taɣzurt tuɣa jar asen.
Xenni iffeɣ-dd ijj n uɛeskari d azeɛɛam zi řmargeḥ n řɛeskar n Ifilisṭiniyyen, qqaren as Juliyat. Tuɣa-t zi Jat. Řuɛřa nnes setta n iɣaǧen d ijj n wezyen n uɣiř.
X uzeǧif nnes tuɣa ijj n lkask n nnḥas, u netta yarḍ arruḍ n wuzzař n uɛeskari s teqcurin. Tuɣa řewzen n warruḍ n wuzzař xemsa-ařaf ciqlu n nnḥas.
Netta tuɣa ɣares iseřqan n ifadden n nnḥas i uḥeṭṭu n iḍaren u jar tɣarḍin nnes yarbu ijj n uḥric n nnḥas.
Aɛmud n lansa nnes tuɣa t am yijj n ukeccuḍ n uxeyyeḍ u tixeft n wuzzař n lansa nnes tewzen setta-mya ciqlu n wuzzař u wenni d as yarebbun taseddart nnes tameqqrant n uɛeskari izwar as.

Netta tuɣa ibedd din, iřaɣa i iseddiyyen n řɛeskar n Israil, inna asen: “Mayemmi i dd-teffɣem u tseddem ixef nwem i umenɣi? War iǧi necc d Afilisṭini u kenniw d imsexxaren n Cawul? Farzem ijj n weryaz i kenniw wenni ɣari dd ɣa ihwan.
Mři xafi izemmar deg umenɣi, ad ayi iwwet, xenni neccin ad niři d imsexxaren nwem, maca mařa necc arebḥeɣ uca ad xas ɣeřbeɣ, xenni kenniw ad tiřim d imsexxaren nneɣ, ad aneɣ tsexxarem.”
Inna Ufilisṭini ɛawed: “Deg wass-a stehziɣ zeg iseddiyyen n řɛeskar n Israil, ad awem iniɣ: ‘Ewc ayi ijj n weryaz maḥend ad nemmneɣ ak-d wayawya!’”
Cawul d marra Israil sřan awařen-a n Ufilisṭini uca nnxeřɛen u ggʷeden aṭṭas.

Dawud tuɣa d mmis n ijj n weryaz zi Ifrata, zi Bayt-Laḥm di temmurt n Yahuda, qqaren as Yassa. Netta tuɣa ɣares tmenya n iḥenjiren u deg wussan n Cawul tuɣa ḥessben t d awessar umi dd-yusa jar yeryazen.

Třata n iḥenjiren imeqqranen n Yassa ḍfaren Cawul ɣar umenɣi. Ismawen n třata n iḥenjiren nnes, inni dd-iffɣen ɣar umenɣi, aqa aten Iliyab, amenzu, u wenni wiss tnayen d Abinadab u wenni wiss třata d Camma.
Tuɣa Dawud d amaẓuẓ uca třata n iḥenjiren imeqqranen tuɣa ḍfaren Cawul.
Dawud tuɣa innum ittraḥ dinni u xenni ittareggʷeḥ-dd zi Cawul, ḥima ad yarwes uǧi n babas di Bayt-Laḥm.
Afilisṭini tuɣa ittas-dd ɣar tuffut u ɣar tmeddit, isscan ixef nnes din, arebɛin n wussan.
Inna Yassa i mmis Dawud: “Ksi ɛafak i aytmac ijj n ifa n teɣwawin-a d ɛecra n tecnifin, awyi tent deɣya ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar ɣar aytmac.
U ɛecra n trussi n uɣi-ya awyi tent ɣar umeqqran x wařef. Arzu x yaytmac, ma mliḥ i iǧan u awyi zzaysen ict n weḍman d jjurret n tudart!”
Cawul d aytmas d marra iryazen n Israil, tuɣa ttmenɣan ak-d Ifilisṭiniyyen di Teɣzurt n Ila.

Ikkar Dawud zic ɣar tuffut, ijja tḥimart n wuǧi ɣar ijj n uɛessas u yiwi marra aya akides uca yuyur am mammec tuɣa i d as t yumur Yassa. Umi dd-yiweḍ ɣar řmargeḥ n ikarruten, řexdenni i iffeɣ řɛeskar ɣar useddi n umenɣi, bdan ad sɣuyen s iɣuyyan n umenɣi.
Israil d Ifilisṭiniyyen sedden ixef nsen i umenɣi, aɣembub n ijj n useddi deg uɣembub n ijj n useddi nneɣni.
Dawud ijja řeḥwayej nni ɣares deg ifassen n ijj n uɛessas n řeḥwayej uca yuzzeř ɣar useddi n řɛeskar. Umi din yiweḍ, isseqsa x yaytmas mammec ǧan nitni.
Řami tuɣa akidsen issawař, xzar, iffeɣ-dd umjahed azeɛɛam nni, qqaren as Julyat zi Jat, zi řɛeskar n Ifilisṭiniyyen. Netta issiweř s wawařen d ijjen u Dawud isřa xas.
Umi ẓrin marra iryazen n Israil aryaz nni, arewřen. Nitni ggʷeden aṭṭas.

Nnan yeryazen n Israil: “Ma teẓrim kenniw mammec i dd-igeɛɛed weryaz nni? Netta igeɛɛed-dd ḥima ad istehza zi Israil. Aryaz wenni t i ɣa iɣeřben, ad t yarr ujeǧid d bu-wagřa ameqqran. Netta ad as iwc yeǧis u ad ikkes x řaǧ n taddart n babas ḍḍariba di Israil.”

Xenni issiweř Dawud ak-d yeryazen inni ɣares dd-ibedden, inna: “Min ɣa ittwagg i weryaz nni i ɣa iwten Afilisṭini-aya, wenni i ɣa ikkes astehzi x Israil? Min iɛna Afilisṭini-aya i war ittwaxetnen, aqa istehza x iseddiyyen n řɛeskar n AREBBI iddaren?”
Yarra-dd xas řgens s wawař d ijjen, nnan: “D man aya i ɣa ittwagg i weryaz nni t i ɣa iɣeřben.”

Umas ameqqran Iliyab isřa as issawař ak-d yeryazen. Yarɣa uxeyyeq n Iliyab x Dawud, inna: “Mayemmi i dd-tehwid cek danita u man wen i umi tejjid taḥimart tameẓyant n wuǧi di řexřa? Necc ssneɣ aɛeffar nnec d tuɛeffna n wuř nnec, minzi cek tehwid-dd danita ḥima ad texzared ɣar umenɣi.”
Dawud inna: “Min ggiɣ řexxu ɛawed? Ma war iǧi mɣir ijj n wawař i sseqsiɣ?”
Netta iḥeyyed xas, iruḥ ɣar ijjen nneɣni, isseqsa aseqsi d ijjen uca yarra-dd xas řgens s wawař d ijjen am mammec dd-arrin nitni twařa tamezwarut.
Nitni sřan i wawařen i tuɣa issawař Dawud uca ssiwřen x man aya zzat i wudem n Cawul u netta ijja ad t-i-dd-awyen.
Inna Dawud i Cawul: “Uřa d ijj n bnadem war ittefciř wuř nnes zeg Ufilisṭini. Amsexxar nnec ad yuyur ad immneɣ ak-d Ufilisṭini.”
Cawul inna i Dawud: “Cek war tzemmared ad traḥed ɣar Ufilisṭini-aya ḥima akides tᵉmmenɣed, maɣar cek d aḥudri ɛad, maca netta d aryaz aɛeskari zi temẓi nnes.”
Xas uca inna Dawud i Cawul: “Amsexxar nnec tuɣa yarekkwes taḥimart n wuǧi n babas. Mařa yusa-dd ijj n weyrad niɣ ijj n ddub, uca iṭṭef ijjen zeg wuǧi n tḥimart,
xenni ḍfareɣ t, wtiɣ t u fekkeɣ-dd izmar zeg uqemmum nnes. Řami dd-ikkar akidi, cebbareɣ as di tmart, wtiɣ t uca nɣiɣ t.
Amsexxar nnec inɣa ayrad uřa d ddub. Ammu i ɣa yiři ak-d Ufilisṭini-aya i war ittwaxetnen, ad as temsar am i yijj n zzaysen, minzi netta istehza zeg iseddiyyen n řɛeskar n AREBBI iddaren.”
Inna Dawud ɛawed: “SIDI wenni d ayi ifekken zeg iceqřaḍen n wayrad u zeg iceqřaḍen n ddub, ad ayi ifekk zeg ufus n Afilisṭini-aya.” Xenni inna Cawul i Dawud: “Uyur, ad kidek yiři SIDI!”
Cawul issyarḍ i Dawud arruḍ nnes n umenɣi, igga as ijj n lkask n nnḥas x uzeǧif nnes u iḥezzem as s yijj n warruḍ n wuzzař.

Icedd Dawud ssif nnes tiwa i warruḍ nnes, inwa ad yuyur cwayt, minzi war t iqeǧeb ɛemmarṣ. Xenni inna Dawud i Cawul: “Necc war zemmareɣ ad uyureɣ di řeḥwayej-a, war tt qeǧbeɣ ɛemmarṣ!” Uca Dawud issars i-tent ɛawed.

Iksi aɛekkaz deg ufus nnes, ixḍar xemsa n iẓra iḥnunnyen zi teɣzart uca igga i-ten di tecyart nnes n tarewsa i ɣares tuɣa, maca mani ten i ɣa yaweḍ deɣya, u tuɣa iǧiy deg ufus nnes. Ammu i iffeɣ ɣar umsagar ak-d Ufilisṭini.
Afilisṭini yuyur, iqarreb-dd ɣar Dawud u wenni d as yarebbun taseddart tameqqrant izwar as.
Umi dd issgeɛɛed Ufilisṭini tamuɣři nnes, iẓra Dawud, isseḥqar i-t, maɣar Dawud tuɣa d aḥudri ɛad, netta tuɣa arrubyu d muṣbiḥ i řxezrat.
Afilisṭini inna i Dawud: “Ma necc d ijj n weqzin, aqa cek tusid-dd ɣari s ikecwaḍ?” Uca Afilisṭini tuɣa ineɛɛeř x Dawud ɣar irebbiten nnes.
Inna Ufilisṭini ɛawed i Dawud: “As-dd ɣari, xenni necc ad wceɣ aysum nnec, maḥend ad t ṣarḍen ijḍaḍ n ujenna d řmař n řexřa.”
Xenni inna Dawud i Ufilisṭini: “Cek tusid-dd ɣari s ssif d lansa d uḥric, maca necc usiɣ-dd ɣarek deg Yisem n SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI n iseddiyyen n řɛeskar n Israil nni zi testᵉhezzid.”

Ass-a ad cek igg SIDI deg ufus inu. Necc ad cek ɣeřbeɣ. Ad ac kkseɣ azeǧif u deg wass-a ad wceɣ řxecbat n řɛeskar n Ifilisṭiniyyen, maḥend ad tent ṣarḍen ijḍaḍ n ujenna d řmař n řexřa. Marra ddunect ad tessen aqa Israil ɣares ijj n AREBBI.
Uřa d marra agraw-a n řgens ad issen aqa SIDI war ittfekki s ssif uřa s lansa, maɣar amenɣi n SIDI u Netta ad cek igg deg ifassen nneɣ.”
Uca imsar, umi Afilisṭini ikkar, iqarreb-dd ɣar Dawud, Dawud igga s tazřa uca yuzzeř ɣar useddi n řɛeskar n řeɛdu i umsagar ak-d Ufilisṭini.
Iwta Dawud ɣar tecyart nnes n tarewsa, ikkes-dd ijj n weẓru, iḥejjar i-t s iǧiy uca iřqef Afilisṭini di tenyart nnes. Aẓru indef i tenyart nnes ařami iwḍa netta x uɣembub nnes ɣar temmurt.
Ammu i iɣřeb Dawud x Ufilisṭini s ijj n yiǧiy d ijj n weẓru. Netta iřqef Afilisṭini, inɣa i-t. War ɣares tuɣi i Dawud qaɛ ssif deg ufus nnes.

Xenni yuzzeř Dawud din ɣar Ufilisṭini u umi dd-ibedd zzates, iṭṭef ssif nnes, ijbed i-t-i-dd zeg weɣraf, inɣa i-t, uca iqess as azeǧif s ssif nnes. Umi ẓrin Ifilisṭiniyyen, aqa bu-teɣruḍt nsen immut, arewřen nitni.
Iryazen n Israil d Yahuda kkaren, sɣuyen ařaɣi n umenɣi uca ḍfaren Ifilisṭiniyyen ař Jat u ař tiwwura n Ɛaqrun. Inni ittwanɣen zeg Ifilisṭiniyyen wḍan deg webrid zi Caɛarayim ař Jat d Ɛaqrun.
Awarni aya ɛeqben-dd ayt n Israil zeg weḍfar s wecnaq n Ifilisṭiniyyen uca keccḍen řemrageḥ n řɛeskar nsen.
Iksi Dawud azeǧif n Ufilisṭini, yiwyi t ɣar Urcalim, maca řesnaḥ nnes igga i-ten deg uqiḍun nnes.

Umi iẓra Cawul aqa Dawud iggur ɣar umsagar ak-d Ufilisṭini, inna netta i Abnir, akumandar n řɛeskar: “Umi igga mmis uḥudri-ya?” Abnir yarra-dd xas: “S tidett am iddar řeɛmar nnec, a ajeǧid, necc war t ssineɣ.”
Ajeǧid inna: “Seqsa xenni umi igga mmis uḥuḍri-ya!”
Umi dd-iɛqeb Dawud awarni i umi tuɣa iɣřeb x Ufilisṭini, yiwyi t akides Abnir, indeh i-t ɣar Cawul. Dawud tuɣa ɣares ɛad azeǧif n Ufilisṭini deg ufus nnes.
Cawul isseqsa t: “Umi teggid mmis cek, a aḥudri?” Dawud yarra-dd xas: “Mmis n umsexxar nnec, n Yassa zi Bayt-Laḥm.”
